problem: Michael goes to a restaurant and orders a sandwich, a salad, and a muffin. In how many different orders can he decide to eat his food?
worked_solution:
There are $3$ foods, so there are $3!$ ways of ordering them:

$$
\begin{aligned}3! & =3\times 2\times 1 \\  & =6.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, there are 6 possible arrangements.
